About.Name: Tamana Muhseny
About.AboutText:

Project1.Title: Embedded Robotics System Senior Design Project
Project1.Desc:
H-Mobile, a home improvement device that will assist users in handling heavy items.
The purpose of H-Mobile is to alleviate strains on the body when people of any age are handling heavy items.

People could experience difficulty in picking up items from the ground to a level where they can easily access the contents.

Project2.Title: AWE in the Context of Disaster Relief Situations Research Project
Project2.Desc:
Research on hybrid AWE + diesel microgrid to power critical infrastructure post-disaster focusing on Guayama, Puerto Rico, a hurricane-prone region.

Allows communities to maintain independent grids when natural disasters disconnect them from the main grid.

The goal of this research is to develop a hybrid AWE + diesel microgrid to power critical infrastructure post-disaster.

And evaluate system feasibility in Guayama, Puerto Rico, a hurricane-prone region.
